company.name: Modal
company.summary: Modal 是一家 AI 基础设施公司，提供计算平台和存储平台，帮助开发者运行推理、沙箱、训练与微调等工作负载，底层容量池横跨 20 多个云。

evidence_refs.quote: Erik Bernhardsson is the Co-founder and CEO of Modal.
CTO Akshat then joined us to talk about Modal’s infra primitives and stack
If you’re interested in joining our team of 200+ across NY, SF, and Stockholm
We threw out most of the existing stack and built our own file system, container runtime, scheduler, and networking from the ground up, on a capacity pool that now spans 20+ clouds.
Founded in 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson and Akshat Bubna, Modal develops cloud infrastructure for artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-intensive applications.
Accel led the round.
Kleiner Perkins joined, and all of our existing investors participated
including Menlo Ventures, General Catalyst, Redpoint, Lux Capital, Amplify Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

products.name: Functions
products.description: 开发者编写代码，Modal 负责在云端运行，适用于扩散模型图像生成、音乐生成、LLM 推理与模型训练等场景。
products.target_customers: AI 应用开发者与 AI 公司

evidence_refs.quote: Functions were our first building block: you write code, and Modal runs it.

products.name: Sandboxes
products.description: 为 AI 智能体提供隔离环境以执行生成代码或不可信代码，已接近 30 亿美元年化收入规模，累计启动近 30 亿个沙箱。
products.target_customers: 构建后台智能体、强化学习、vibecoding 平台的开发者

evidence_refs.quote: it’s a $300M run rate product just on its own.

products.name: Modal servers
products.description: 面向 HTTP 服务器的推理侧产品，并提供 LLM 服务相关功能如 Endpoint Candidates。
products.target_customers: 需要部署推理服务的 AI 开发者

evidence_refs.quote: we’ve been launching Modal servers, which is a better solution for HTTP servers

products.name: Modal
products.description: 一个为 AI 工作负载构建的通用计算平台，提供低延迟弹性推理、动态智能体运行时、强化学习、大规模批处理作业和沙箱等原语，支持开发者构建从模型微调到生产推理的完整技术栈。
products.target_customers: AI 原生公司、数字原生企业以及需要大规模 AI 计算能力的开发团队
features: 从 0 到 1,000 GPU 分钟级扩展

evidence_refs.quote: Modal is a cloud built for AI. Not a single-purpose GPU cloud, but a platform with the right primitives for developers to build a very wide range of applications. Today, this looks like low-latency elastic inference, dynamic agent runtimes, reinforcement learning, batch jobs at massive scale, and much more.
